summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 61 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Half of Gen Z Uses AI, but Their Feelings Are Souring, Study Shows
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Fraud Rockets Higher in Mobile-First Latin America
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
